scope: Measure cost of rejecting known affected-row mismatches, not all-scenario or upstream optimization proof
retention: Keep required safety fix if its assertions pass; report all measured gains/losses and minimum per-pair 25/50 gates without changing thresholds
storage: Existing one-million-row source; reset one target sequentially; 6GiB guard and per-backend temp limit
isolation: No builds, compression, other DB tests or DataX jobs during performance rounds
